comprehensibility.reason: Self-contained; terms are standard domain vocabulary.

feasibility.reason: Implementable with known automotive technology; contradicts nothing stated.

parent_fit.reason: In this CCS-only product the parent ARCH_CHG_INLET alternative mentions no contact temperature monitoring, so the derating engages only tangentially with it.
parent_fit.suggestion: Add contact temperature monitoring to every ARCH_CHG_INLET alternative, or refine the derating from the element that owns the temperature sensing.

unambiguity.reason: No release condition: leaving the derated state at exactly 90 °C is unspecified (chattering).

variant_consistency.reason: Lives in subsystems/chg (bev-only folder); every alternative of the parent is also inside bev and the market/inlet alternatives are exhaustive (Kconfig: region eu|na; mcs needs v800 needs bev), so the need never exists without a parent.
